scope: v3.1 Blender-evidence round: visitors (new), airlock (S/M/L), doors, doorway_decals (13 room types), landing_pad (new, part of ships), ships (after round-11 fixes). No in-game evidence.

what_works: Every kind differs from the colonist and from each other at 55 px in both variants (visitors_lineup.png): orange trader, white-with-accent tourists (cyan/green/pink), red-cross medical, blue science, black-gold inspector.
Attachments are small and on the body: camera, pennant, crosses, sensor mast, cap, epaulettes (visitors_turnaround.png close-ups).
suit_swap reads: hands to the helmet, hold, hands to the chest seals, back to stand (transitions.png, s and i suit_swap 0-60).

fixes.fix: At 30 px the three tourist sets and the science visitor are all 'white with a colour patch'; the patch is only on the chest/collar. Carry the tourist colour to the helmet (suit, done) AND to the lower legs/boots on the indoor variant, so a tourist reads from the back and from above.

Indoor trader: an orange jumpsuit with a grey vest is close to the orange-role colonist accent at 30 px. Make the vest a darker graphite with a hi-vis yellow stripe, or give the trader a hat, so it is not read as a colonist.
Black inspector suit at night: not checked (maker's note). Add gold reflective stripes on the legs and pack so it can be found at night; RENDER to show it in the in-game round.
The indoor inspector cap does not fit head 1 (bun); instead of RENDER skipping that head, give the cap a bun cut-out or a lower-crown variant.

round_10_fixes_checked.cut at 1.40 m: partly true. The chamber side walls and the door housings in the cutaway renders (airlock_closed.png, airlock_m.png, airlock_l.png) still stand above the outer wall ring - about 2.2-2.5 m by comparison with the lockers and suit racks. The claim that the chamber is cut at 1.40 m is not borne out by the images; the housings especially. Only the roof is removed.
round_10_fixes_checked.chamber 2.4 m (M) and 3.6 m (L): landed; L reads as a real walk-through chamber
round_10_fixes_checked.amber beacon and pressure lights: beacon landed (amber disc on the block roof); pressure lights present but tiny

fixes.fix: Cut the chamber walls and door housings at 1.40 m in the cutaway, with solid caps, as every room wall (V3_1 3.2). If the housings must stay tall for the door kit, put their upper parts in the Roof/…Top group so they lift with the roof. Show one cutaway render with the housings at 1.40 m.
Pressure lights: 3 lamps 8 cm wide on a dark plate above the inner door, so they read from the game camera.

round_10_fixes_checked.housing follows the wall, rounded corner: landed; inside it now reads as part of the wall, outside the hood follows the dome on dome rooms

fixes.fix: Water recycler M (and any podium room with tanks at the wall): the door hood cuts through a wall tank and its dome cap (art/critic/r12_wr_roof.png). Move the tank to the next free segment when a doorway takes its segment, or hide it with the segment.

Flat-roof rooms (refinery, storehouse, assembler): the curved hood sits on the flat roof as a separate white shell (art/critic/r12_ref_roof.png). Use a flat hood on flat-roof rooms, flush with the roof edge.

doorway_decals.what_works: 13 room types with 2-3 doorways each: no band, porthole, stripe or sign on any opening, roof on or cutaway; bands end with a cap (r12_dw1.png, r12_dw2.png).

fixes.fix: In-game acceptance on every room type (zero decal pixels in an opening). About 90 decal objects per room: merge them per room (ART-HAB's note).
The upper wall patch is plain (no band) beside doors on podium/drum rooms (water recycler, refinery): the upper band stops a full segment early. Carry the band to the cap as on the lower wall.

what_works: Round-9/11 notes landed: kiosk outside the footprint and ramp lanes, 20 amber edge lights, one purple ring, blast deflector, fuel station with a floor fuel line, two light masts, apron (pad31_*).
The trader sits centred with room for carriers (pad31_trader_top.png).

fixes.fix: Blast deflector reads as a row of flat grey boards on posts. Give it an angled face (30-40 deg back), a Frame top rail, scorch darkening on the ship side and a hazard stripe.

The fuel station and the kiosk are small white boxes at game distance. Give the fuel station a hose reel and a red/yellow fuel stripe; give the kiosk a lit window and a mast light so both read at night.
The apron is a flat dark ring. Add tie-down points and 4 painted walkway lanes to the ramp lanes so carriers' routes read.

round_11_fixes_checked.1 shuttle top: landed: graphite roof, yellow stripe, raised deck; distinct from above
round_11_fixes_checked.2 liner dart: landed: tapered nose, delta wings, pink spine band; the most distinct plan
round_11_fixes_checked.5 night ramp renders: delivered, but no belly or door flood is visible: ramps and the deck under each ship are dark (r12_nightramp.png)
round_11_fixes_checked.6 trader ramp: landed: side ramp at the tail

fixes.fix: Belly and ramp floods: make them visible - an emissive lens under the belly at each ramp and a warm pool on the ramp and the deck (RENDER in game; ART-B in the render with a real light). A landed ship at night should show where people walk.

Medical and science from above still share the trader-like capsule with two engines; the cross and the dish carry them. Acceptable; optional: give the medical ship a flat white roof deck with a helipad-like cross ring.

notes: No FAIL. Nothing reaches 0.80; airlock, doors and doorway_decals are at 0.79.

Claim not borne out: ART-HAB says the airlock chamber is cut at 1.40 m; in the cutaway renders the chamber walls and door housings stand well above the outer wall (airlock_closed.png, airlock_m.png, airlock_l.png).
